title: 維京聯網直流互聯
subcategoryTitleEn: Landmark storage, transmission and hydrogen projects
summary: 維京聯網連接英格蘭東部的林肯郡與丹麥的日德蘭半島，全長約 765 公里、容量 1,400 MW，2023 年底啟用時是世界上最長的陸海聯網電纜。兩端都是風力發電占比很高的電網：風暴由西向東橫過北海，英國的風場先發電，幾個小時後才輪到丹麥。它啟用初期因為丹麥端的電網還沒有加強完成，只能送 800 MW。課程定量分析兩地風電的互補效果、容量限制的影響、陸上電纜的接頭數與土壤溫升、成束敷設的磁場與海床埋設的工期。
summaryEn: Viking Link joins Lincolnshire in eastern England with Jutland in Denmark, about 765 kilometres and 1,400 MW, the longest land-and-sea interconnector in the world when it opened at the end of 2023. Both ends are grids with a high share of wind: storms cross the North Sea from west to east, British wind farms generating first and Danish ones hours later. At first it could carry only 800 MW because grid reinforcement at the Danish end was unfinished. The course quantifies how the two wind fleets complement each other, the effect of the capacity limit, joints and soil heating of land cable, magnetic field of bundled cables and time to bury on the seabed.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.

v30FocusEn: The longest interconnector, joining Britain and Denmark: complementary wind, early capacity limit, land cable joints and heating, magnetic field and burial

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：維京聯網直流互聯
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: Viking Link HVDC Interconnector
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「兩地風電的互補」與「可用率與輸電量」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "How two wind fleets complement each other" and "Availability and energy transferred": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「兩地風電的互補」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "How two wind fleets complement each other" is correct?
options: 英國與丹麥相隔六百多公里，同一個天氣系統要幾個小時才能由一邊走到另一邊；兩地的風電出力雖然相關，卻不完全同步。
把夠多的風場連起來，總會有地方在颳風。
輸電線路沒有活動零件，蓋好之後就永遠可用。
optionsEn: Britain and Denmark lie over six hundred kilometres apart, and one weather system takes hours to pass from one to the other; their wind output is correlated but not in step.
Join enough wind farms and it is always windy somewhere.
A transmission link has no moving parts and is available forever once built.
quiz.explanation: 英國與丹麥相隔六百多公里，同一個天氣系統要幾個小時才能由一邊走到另一邊；兩地的風電出力雖然相關，卻不完全同步。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Britain and Denmark lie over six hundred kilometres apart, and one weather system takes hours to pass from one to the other; their wind output is correlated but not in step. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 兩地風電的互補：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: How two wind fleets complement each other: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「兩地風電的互補」如何決定「維京聯網直流互聯」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “How two wind fleets complement each other” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Viking Link HVDC Interconnector”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 英國與丹麥相隔六百多公里，同一個天氣系統要幾個小時才能由一邊走到另一邊；兩地的風電出力雖然相關，卻不完全同步。統計上，兩個波動的來源相加之後，總和的相對波動幅度取決於它們之間的相關係數：完全同步時一點也沒有減少，完全無關時降為七成。相關係數零點三時，合起來的波動大約是各自的八成。聯網線讓兩個電網共用彼此的風——這邊多的時候送過去，那邊多的時候送回來——兩邊需要的備用電源都減少了。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Britain and Denmark lie over six hundred kilometres apart, and one weather system takes hours to pass from one to the other; their wind output is correlated but not in step. Statistically, when two fluctuating sources are added, relative fluctuation of the sum depends on the correlation between them: none is removed if fully in step, and it falls to seven tenths if unrelated. At a correlation of 0.3 the combined fluctuation is about eight tenths of each alone. The link lets two grids share each other's wind, sending surplus one way or the other, and both need less reserve. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：聯網線全長約 765 km
steps.observationEn: Project file: The interconnector is about 765 km long
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「把夠多的風場連起來，總會有地方在颳風。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Join enough wind farms and it is always windy somewhere." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「兩地風電的互補」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “How two wind fleets complement each other”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 依「兩地風電的互補」的模型 σ/σ₀ = √((1 + ρ)/2)，兩地風電出力的相關係數為 0.3 時，合併後的相對波動幅度相對於單一地區的比例（教學假設）最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model σ/σ₀ = √((1 + ρ)/2) for "How two wind fleets complement each other", which value is closest to the relative fluctuation of the combined output against one region alone at a correlation of 0.3 between the two wind fleets (teaching assumption)?
quiz.explanation: σ/σ₀ = √((1 + ρ)/2)；代入 ρ = 0.3，得 80.6 %（兩地風電出力的相關係數為 0.3 時，合併後的相對波動幅度相對於單一地區的比例（教學假設））。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: σ/σ₀ = √((1 + ρ)/2); with ρ = 0.3 the result is 80.6 % (relative fluctuation of the combined output against one region alone at a correlation of 0.3 between the two wind fleets (teaching assumption)). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 兩地風電的互補：定量估算
steps.titleEn: How two wind fleets complement each other: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「兩地風電的互補」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “How two wind fleets complement each other” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：σ/σ₀ = √((1 + ρ)/2)；代入 ρ = 0.3，得 80.6 %（兩地風電出力的相關係數為 0.3 時，合併後的相對波動幅度相對於單一地區的比例（教學假設））。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 ρ 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: σ/σ₀ = √((1 + ρ)/2); with ρ = 0.3 the result is 80.6 % (relative fluctuation of the combined output against one region alone at a correlation of 0.3 between the two wind fleets (teaching assumption)). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise ρ by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：ρ 增加 10% 時，結果變為 81.5 %（+1.1%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising ρ by 10% changes the result to 81.5 % (+1.1%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 80.6 %（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 ρ 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 80.6 % (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in ρ with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: σ/σ₀ = √((1 + ρ)/2)；代入 ρ = 0.3，得 80.6 %（兩地風電出力的相關係數為 0.3 時，合併後的相對波動幅度相對於單一地區的比例（教學假設））。
knowledge.textEn: σ/σ₀ = √((1 + ρ)/2); with ρ = 0.3 the result is 80.6 % (relative fluctuation of the combined output against one region alone at a correlation of 0.3 between the two wind fleets (teaching assumption)).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: ρ 增加 10% 時，結果變為 81.5 %（+1.1%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising ρ by 10% changes the result to 81.5 % (+1.1%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「兩地風電的互補」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "How two wind fleets complement each other"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
陸上的電纜工程比海上的簡單得多。
以兩國多年的逐時風電出力資料計算相關係數，並分析不同季節與天氣型態下的差異。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Cable work on land is far simpler than at sea.
Years of hourly wind output from both countries give the correlation, with differences by season and weather type analysed.
quiz.explanation: 以兩國多年的逐時風電出力資料計算相關係數，並分析不同季節與天氣型態下的差異。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Years of hourly wind output from both countries give the correlation, with differences by season and weather type analysed. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 兩地風電的互補：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: How two wind fleets complement each other: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「兩地風電的互補」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “How two wind fleets complement each other” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以兩國多年的逐時風電出力資料計算相關係數，並分析不同季節與天氣型態下的差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Years of hourly wind output from both countries give the correlation, with differences by season and weather type analysed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：聯網的容量價值要以兩地同時低風速的機率評估，而不是以平均的互補效果估算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Judge capacity value of an interconnector from the probability of low wind in both places at once, not from mean complementarity.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：大範圍的高壓系統籠罩整個北海時，兩國同時連續數日無風，聯網線兩端都沒有多餘的電可送。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: When a broad high-pressure system sits over the whole North Sea, both countries are windless for days and neither end has surplus to send. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 兩地風電的互補：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: How two wind fleets complement each other: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「兩地風電的互補」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “How two wind fleets complement each other” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 大範圍的高壓系統籠罩整個北海時，兩國同時連續數日無風，聯網線兩端都沒有多餘的電可送。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「維京聯網直流互聯」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: When a broad high-pressure system sits over the whole North Sea, both countries are windless for days and neither end has surplus to send. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Viking Link HVDC Interconnector”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：聯網線讓兩個電網共用彼此的風——這邊多的時候送過去，那邊多的時候送回來——兩邊需要的備用電源都減少了。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The link lets two grids share each other's wind, sending surplus one way or the other, and both need less reserve.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「把夠多的風場連起來，總會有地方在颳風。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Join enough wind farms and it is always windy somewhere." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 大範圍的高壓系統籠罩整個北海時，兩國同時連續數日無風，聯網線兩端都沒有多餘的電可送。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Availability and energy transferred" is correct?
options: 輸電線路沒有活動零件，蓋好之後就永遠可用。
換流站只是大型變壓器，損失和一般變電站差不多。
聯網線與輸電工程的價值以實際輸送的電量衡量，取決於容量、可用率與利用率。
optionsEn: A transmission link has no moving parts and is available forever once built.
A converter station is just a big transformer with losses like an ordinary substation.
The value of an interconnector or transmission project is measured in energy actually delivered, which depends on capacity, availability and utilisation.
quiz.explanation: 聯網線與輸電工程的價值以實際輸送的電量衡量，取決於容量、可用率與利用率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The value of an interconnector or transmission project is measured in energy actually delivered, which depends on capacity, availability and utilisation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 可用率與輸電量：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Availability and energy transferred: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「可用率與輸電量」如何決定「維京聯網直流互聯」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Availability and energy transferred” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “Viking Link HVDC Interconnector”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 聯網線與輸電工程的價值以實際輸送的電量衡量，取決於容量、可用率與利用率。高壓直流系統的能量可用率一般在 95% 至 98%，其中計畫性年度檢修占一至兩週，強迫停運則主要來自控制保護誤動作、換流變壓器與電纜故障。海纜故障雖然罕見，但修復時間長達數月，往往決定了長期平均可用率。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The value of an interconnector or transmission project is measured in energy actually delivered, which depends on capacity, availability and utilisation. Energy availability of HVDC systems is generally 95–98%, with one or two weeks of planned annual maintenance and forced outages mainly from control and protection maloperation, converter transformers and cable faults. Subsea cable faults are rare but take months to repair and often decide long-term average availability. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：輸送容量為 1,400 MW，直流電壓為 ±525 kV
steps.observationEn: Project file: Capacity is 1,400 MW at ±525 kV DC
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「輸電線路沒有活動零件，蓋好之後就永遠可用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A transmission link has no moving parts and is available forever once built." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「可用率與輸電量」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Availability and energy transferred”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 可用率與輸電量
knowledge.text: 聯網線與輸電工程的價值以實際輸送的電量衡量，取決於容量、可用率與利用率。高壓直流系統的能量可用率一般在 95% 至 98%，其中計畫性年度檢修占一至兩週，強迫停運則主要來自控制保護誤動作、換流變壓器與電纜故障。海纜故障雖然罕見，但修復時間長達數月，往往決定了長期平均可用率。
knowledge.textEn: The value of an interconnector or transmission project is measured in energy actually delivered, which depends on capacity, availability and utilisation. Energy availability of HVDC systems is generally 95–98%, with one or two weeks of planned annual maintenance and forced outages mainly from control and protection maloperation, converter transformers and cable faults. Subsea cable faults are rare but take months to repair and often decide long-term average availability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：輸電線路沒有活動零件，蓋好之後就永遠可用。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A transmission link has no moving parts and is available forever once built. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 輸送容量為 1,400 MW，直流電壓為 ±525 kV
knowledge.textEn: Capacity is 1,400 MW at ±525 kV DC

quiz.question: 依「可用率與輸電量」的模型 E = P·8760·a，以額定容量與代表性可用率計算的年最大輸電量最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model E = P·8760·a for "Availability and energy transferred", which value is closest to the maximum annual energy transfer from rated capacity and representative availability?
options: 11.9 TWh
119 TWh
5.95 TWh
optionsEn: 11.9 TWh
119 TWh
5.95 TWh
quiz.explanation: E = P·8760·a；代入 Pdc = 1400 MW、av = 0.97，得 11.9 TWh（以額定容量與代表性可用率計算的年最大輸電量）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: E = P·8760·a; with Pdc = 1400 MW, av = 0.97 the result is 11.9 TWh (maximum annual energy transfer from rated capacity and representative availability). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 可用率與輸電量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Availability and energy transferred: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可用率與輸電量」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Availability and energy transferred” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：E = P·8760·a；代入 Pdc = 1400 MW、av = 0.97，得 11.9 TWh（以額定容量與代表性可用率計算的年最大輸電量）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 av 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: E = P·8760·a; with Pdc = 1400 MW, av = 0.97 the result is 11.9 TWh (maximum annual energy transfer from rated capacity and representative availability). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise av by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：av 增加 10% 時，結果變為 13.1 TWh（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising av by 10% changes the result to 13.1 TWh (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 11.9 TWh（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 av 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 11.9 TWh (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in av with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: E = P·8760·a；代入 Pdc = 1400 MW、av = 0.97，得 11.9 TWh（以額定容量與代表性可用率計算的年最大輸電量）。
knowledge.textEn: E = P·8760·a; with Pdc = 1400 MW, av = 0.97 the result is 11.9 TWh (maximum annual energy transfer from rated capacity and representative availability).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: av 增加 10% 時，結果變為 13.1 TWh（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising av by 10% changes the result to 13.1 TWh (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「可用率與輸電量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Availability and energy transferred"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
依 CIGRE 的高壓直流系統可靠度調查方法，逐年統計計畫與強迫停運的能量不可用率，並把每次強迫停運歸類到設備別以找出弱點。
直流輸電完全沒有損失。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
Using the CIGRE protocol for HVDC reliability surveys, record yearly scheduled and forced energy unavailability and classify each forced outage by equipment to find weak points.
DC transmission has no losses at all.
quiz.explanation: 依 CIGRE 的高壓直流系統可靠度調查方法，逐年統計計畫與強迫停運的能量不可用率，並把每次強迫停運歸類到設備別以找出弱點。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Using the CIGRE protocol for HVDC reliability surveys, record yearly scheduled and forced energy unavailability and classify each forced outage by equipment to find weak points. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 可用率與輸電量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Availability and energy transferred: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「可用率與輸電量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Availability and energy transferred” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依 CIGRE 的高壓直流系統可靠度調查方法，逐年統計計畫與強迫停運的能量不可用率，並把每次強迫停運歸類到設備別以找出弱點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Using the CIGRE protocol for HVDC reliability surveys, record yearly scheduled and forced energy unavailability and classify each forced outage by equipment to find weak points. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：長交期設備（換流變壓器、備用海纜與接頭）要在投運前備妥，並每年檢視備品狀態與修復船舶的可得性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Long-lead equipment such as converter transformers, spare cable and joints should be in store before commissioning, with spares condition and repair-vessel availability reviewed every year.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：換流變壓器因直流偏磁、套管或有載分接開關故障而損壞時，若沒有備用相，更換一台需要一年以上的製造與運輸時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: When a converter transformer fails from DC bias, bushing or tap-changer faults and no spare phase exists, replacement takes more than a year of manufacture and transport. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 依 CIGRE 的高壓直流系統可靠度調查方法，逐年統計計畫與強迫停運的能量不可用率，並把每次強迫停運歸類到設備別以找出弱點。
knowledge.textEn: Using the CIGRE protocol for HVDC reliability surveys, record yearly scheduled and forced energy unavailability and classify each forced outage by equipment to find weak points.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 長交期設備（換流變壓器、備用海纜與接頭）要在投運前備妥，並每年檢視備品狀態與修復船舶的可得性。
knowledge.textEn: Long-lead equipment such as converter transformers, spare cable and joints should be in store before commissioning, with spares condition and repair-vessel availability reviewed every year.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 60633／IEC 62747 高壓直流輸電術語（LCC 與 VSC）。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 60633 / IEC 62747 Terminology for HVDC transmission (LCC and VSC). Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「可用率與輸電量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Availability and energy transferred" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
換流站只是大型變壓器，損失和一般變電站差不多。
換流變壓器因直流偏磁、套管或有載分接開關故障而損壞時，若沒有備用相，更換一台需要一年以上的製造與運輸時間。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
A converter station is just a big transformer with losses like an ordinary substation.
When a converter transformer fails from DC bias, bushing or tap-changer faults and no spare phase exists, replacement takes more than a year of manufacture and transport.
quiz.explanation: 換流變壓器因直流偏磁、套管或有載分接開關故障而損壞時，若沒有備用相，更換一台需要一年以上的製造與運輸時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: When a converter transformer fails from DC bias, bushing or tap-changer faults and no spare phase exists, replacement takes more than a year of manufacture and transport. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 可用率與輸電量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Availability and energy transferred: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可用率與輸電量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Availability and energy transferred” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 換流變壓器因直流偏磁、套管或有載分接開關故障而損壞時，若沒有備用相，更換一台需要一年以上的製造與運輸時間。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「維京聯網直流互聯」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: When a converter transformer fails from DC bias, bushing or tap-changer faults and no spare phase exists, replacement takes more than a year of manufacture and transport. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “Viking Link HVDC Interconnector”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：海纜故障雖然罕見，但修復時間長達數月，往往決定了長期平均可用率。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Subsea cable faults are rare but take months to repair and often decide long-term average availability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「輸電線路沒有活動零件，蓋好之後就永遠可用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A transmission link has no moving parts and is available forever once built." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 換流變壓器因直流偏磁、套管或有載分接開關故障而損壞時，若沒有備用相，更換一台需要一年以上的製造與運輸時間。
knowledge.textEn: When a converter transformer fails from DC bias, bushing or tap-changer faults and no spare phase exists, replacement takes more than a year of manufacture and transport.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
